description: This file defines a Java interface 'LogNode' for a logging system. The interface specifies a method 'println' used to output log data, including log level, tag, message, and optional exception information. It is intended to be implemented by classes that handle logging to various targets or filters within an Android application.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node that can output log messages or pass them along a chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.
